hypothesis: R221 SG&A intensity captures cost discipline, while R223 gross-margin stability captures pricing power and business resilience. Their low observed cross-sectional correlation suggests that equal-weighting them inside the factor sleeve may improve robustness without changing the quality and cash controls.

composite_factor.definition: equal-weight average of the two component scores after the platform's standard cross-sectional min-max normalization; component weights are fixed before the strategy backtest
composite_factor.availability: both component factors must be non-null; no filling, fallback, or single-factor substitution
composite_factor.universe: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, both-factor availability filter and execution; neither component factor is a score component.

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: intersection coverage of both component factors within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid intersection value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m intersection coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation between the two components is at most 0.70
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The component definitions, 50/50 composite weighting, outer scoring weights, non-financial universe, holding period and stop loss are frozen before the strategy backtest. No post-result relaxation, reweighting, filling, or single-factor substitution is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
The financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
The composite is a strategy-level score, not a new raw data field; it is traceable through the two component factor weights.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
